candidate_change.role: Sensitive screening layer; not the primary permanent-change figure.

bands.name: END_CLASS
bands.description: Built Area (7) or Bare Ground (8) in first detected change year.

bands.name: TEMPORAL_SCORE
bands.description: Temporal evidence-agreement score; not a calibrated probability.

bands.name: STATUS
bands.description: 1 = candidate confirmed under original two-year persistence rule; 2 = provisional 2025.

permanent_change.role: Primary layer for permanent-change area reporting.

bands.name: CHANGE_YEAR
bands.description: First year of strict permanent conversion.

bands.name: BASELINE_CLASS
bands.description: Same vegetation class observed in 2018, 2019 and 2020.

bands.name: FIRST_END_CLASS
bands.description: Built Area (7) or Bare Ground (8) in first permanent-change year.

bands.name: PERSISTENCE_YEARS
bands.description: Continuous Built/Bare years from first change through 2025.

bands.name: BASELINE_STABILITY
bands.description: 3 for selected pixels: same monitored vegetation class in all three baseline years.

area_computation_note: For portal reports, use polygon-raster intersection and area-aware computation; do not rely only on whole-pixel count at polygon edges.
